headline: 聯準會整修案查無不法
context: 聯準會（Fed）內部監察長公布報告，指出總部一項耗資約24億至25億美元的整修工程管理不善，但沒有違法或刑事情事。川普過去一年多次拿這項整修案攻擊聯準會與前主席鮑爾（Jerome Powell），施壓要求降息，司法部原本也曾介入調查，今年4月已撤案。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Trump criticized $2.4bn rehab amid attempts to pressure then Fed chair Jerome Powell into lowering interest rates An internal watchdog said the Federal Reserve mismanaged costs associated with a $2.4bn renovation of its Washington DC headquarters, but noted that no criminal violations occurred, according to a report released on Wednesday. For over a year, Donald Trump has centered his attacks against the Fed and former chair Jerome Powell around the renovations, including a months-long Department of Justice criminal investigation that was dropped in April. Continue reading...
sources.title: Federal Reserve watchdog finds no criminal violations for building renovation cost overruns

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: A new report by the Federal Reserve’s independent inspector general concluded that a nearly $2.5 billion construction project was poorly managed but made no referrals to the U.S. attorney general.
sources.title: Fed’s Watchdog Finds No Misconduct or Illegal Activity in Costly Renovations

threads_text:
聯準會整修案查無不法

聯準會內部監察長公布報告，指出總部一項耗資約24億至25億美元的整修工程管理不善，但沒有違法或刑事情事。川普過去一年多次拿這項整修案攻擊聯準會與前主席鮑爾（Jerome Powell），施壓要求降息，司法部原本也曾介入調查，今年4月已撤案。

本則整理自衛報與紐約時報於 2026 年 10 月 1 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 聯準會那項耗資約24億到25億美元的總部整修工程，被查出管理不善，但沒有違法或刑事情事。川普過去一年多次拿這件事攻擊聯準會，還有前主席鮑爾，希望藉此施壓降息。司法部原本也介入調查過，但今年4月已經撤案。
